description: This file is a PHP script that generates various types of documentation reports related to test plans, requirements, and test specifications within a testing management system. It includes logic for initializing parameters, loading environment details, constructing report content based on different report types, and rendering the final document output. The file references external configuration files and includes functions for gathering and processing test-related data.

classes.name: requirement_spec_mgr
classes.description: Class for managing requirement specifications, used to fetch requirement spec data from the database.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class representing a test plan, providing methods to retrieve test plan information and associated data.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class representing a test project, used to access details about a project.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Class for managing test suites; used to retrieve suite data and hierarchy.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: User management class for retrieving user information and permissions.

classes.name: printDocOptions
classes.description: Class for handling options related to document printing configuration.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves input parameters, sets up environment context based on request data.

methods.name: initPrintOpt
methods.description: Initializes printing options based on user input and default configuration.

methods.name: getDecode
methods.description: Retrieves decoding mappings for node types and status codes used in processing the project tree.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Sets up environment variables, filters, and options based on the user and project context.

methods.name: getStatsEstimatedExecTime
methods.description: Computes estimated execution time statistics for a test plan, optionally broken down by platform.

methods.name: getStatsRealExecTime
methods.description: Calculates real execution time based on actual test case execution data.

methods.name: buildContentForTestPlan
methods.description: Builds hierarchical content for a test plan across different platforms, fetching linked test cases.

methods.name: buildContentForTestPlanBranch
methods.description: Constructs content for a specific branch (sub-suite) within a test plan.

methods.name: timeStatistics
methods.description: Aggregates estimated and real execution time statistics for display.
